about: Written by notes/cross_correlations/plots/make_cross_correlations_data.py from the project's data/lssty1xdesi_desi_<layout>.nz, _bins.txt and _pairs.txt. Each bin's raw n(z) is given on the DESI redshift nodes (spacing dz_node) from z_first on, scaled to unit peak. Pairs and bins are 0-based in data-vector order; 'touching' is the pairing rule of scripts/make_desi_dz_case.py (raw ranges overlap or come within 1.5 node steps) applied to each listed pair. unmeasured_near: the pairs not in the data vector whose FoG-convolved n(z) overlap by more than 1e-6 (see fog_smearing/data.json). lrg3_elg1_range is where the raw LRG3 and ELG1 ranges intersect.
